tagline: Modern Sacred Luxury • Rooms • Banquet • Mohan Ji Poori Wale
directorQuote: At Hotel Mohan Inn, we take pride in serving every guest with authentic Indian hospitality and sacred warmth. Whether visiting for the holy dip at Har Ki Pauri or proceeding to the Himalayas, our team is committed to making your stay cherished forever.
address: Khasra no 698, NH-334 / NH 58, Haridwar-Delhi Highway, Bahadarabad, Haridwar, Uttarakhand – 249423 (Near CNG Station)

hero.badge: SINCE BAHADARABAD • NH-58 • 10 MINS FROM HAR KI PAURI
hero.subtext: Welcoming pilgrims and discerning travelers to Haridwar’s premier hospitality sanctuary. Featuring 32 boutique AC rooms, a 150-guest grand banquet ballroom, dedicated Char Dham Yatra desk, and the legendary 200-capacity Mohan Ji Poori Wale pure vegetarian dining heritage.

standard.desc: Exceptional comfort spanning 200 sqft. Features a dedicated solid-wood writing desk, seating lounge, high-speed Wi-Fi, LED television, and in-room tea/coffee amenities.

deluxe.desc: Freshly refurbished with contemporary styling and mountain vistas. Equipped with king bedding, ambient lighting controls, 24/7 hot/cold shower, and breakfast inclusions.

family.desc: Our most spacious signature suite spanning 350 sqft. Solely furnished to ensure the highest standard of family hospitality with twin double beds, luxury bath, and sofa lounge.

restaurant.heading: A Sacred Feast for Soul & Senses
restaurant.desc: Our chefs preserve centuries-old secret spice blends cooked in pure desi ghee. From the crisp golden crunch of morning balloon pooris to aromatic tawa rotis, rich paneer specialties, and soothing clay-pot masala chai, every meal is prepared with sattvic reverence.

dish1.name: Signature Bedmi Poori & Mathura Aloo
dish1.desc: Crispy urad dal stuffed poori with spicy hing-infused potato curry & sweet pumpkin subzi.

dish2.name: Shahi Kesar Sooji Halwa
dish2.desc: Slow-roasted semolina in pure cow ghee, garnished with saffron strands, cashews & almonds.

dish3.name: Royal Shivalik Paneer Thali
dish3.desc: Fresh cottage cheese in makhani gravy, yellow dal tadka, jeera rice, tandoori rotis, raita & salad.

yatra.heading: Char Dham Yatra & Local Concierge
yatra.desc: Ideally located on Haridwar-Delhi Highway NH 58 in Bahadarabad, serving as the stress-free starting sanctuary for the holy Char Dham pilgrimage (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath).

policies.childPolicy: Children under 5 stay free with parents (without extra bed)
policies.rules: All rates on twin sharing basis. Advance deposit required for guaranteed confirmation.
